chemistry-killer-02.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
chemistry-killer-02.topic: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
chemistry-killer-02.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-02.material:
Kubushushu noxinzelelo olungatshintshiyo, i-hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) isabela ne-oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) ukwenza umphunga wamanzi ($\mathrm{H_2O}$(g)). Ngxubevange zegesi ezahlukeneyo zasabela ngokupheleleyo kwaye umthamo ophelele wegesi walinganiswa kubushushu noxinzelelo olufanayo (onke amanzi yigesi).
(A) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL -> iyonke 35 mL emva kokusabela
(B) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL -> iyonke 30 mL emva kokusabela
Ungxubevange we-60 mL we-$\mathrm{H_2}$ kunye ne-$\mathrm{O_2}$ wasabela ngokupheleleyo kubushushu noxinzelelo olufanayo. Umthamo opheleleyo emva kokusabela wawu-45 mL kwaye yigesi enye kuphela eyashiyekayo yi-$\mathrm{O_2}$ (akusali $\mathrm{H_2}$). Sesiphi isibini esinika ngokuchanekileyo umthamo we-$\mathrm{H_2}$ ngaphambi kokusabela kunye nomthamo we-$\mathrm{O_2}$ oshiyekileyo emva kokusabela, ngokulandelelana?
chemistry-killer-02.thinking.0: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.prompt:
Kubushushu noxinzelelo olungatshintshiyo, i-hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) isabela ne-oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) ukwenza umphunga wamanzi ($\mathrm{H_2O}$(g)). Ngxubevange zegesi ezahlukeneyo zasabela ngokupheleleyo kwaye umthamo ophelele wegesi walinganiswa kubushushu noxinzelelo olufanayo (onke amanzi yigesi).
(A) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL -> iyonke 35 mL emva kokusabela
(B) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL -> iyonke 30 mL emva kokusabela
Ungxubevange we-60 mL we-$\mathrm{H_2}$ kunye ne-$\mathrm{O_2}$ wasabela ngokupheleleyo kubushushu noxinzelelo olufanayo. Umthamo opheleleyo emva kokusabela wawu-45 mL kwaye yigesi enye kuphela eyashiyekayo yi-$\mathrm{O_2}$ (akusali $\mathrm{H_2}$). Sesiphi isibini esinika ngokuchanekileyo umthamo we-$\mathrm{H_2}$ ngaphambi kokusabela kunye nomthamo we-$\mathrm{O_2}$ oshiyekileyo emva kokusabela, ngokulandelelana?
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ukusuka kwi-(A) nakwi-(B) umlinganiselo womthamo. (B): 20 mL ye-H2 isabela ne-10 mL ye-O2 inike i-20 mL ye-H2O, kushiyeke i-10 mL ye-O2, iyonke 30 mL. (A): 30 mL ye-H2 isabela ne-15 mL ye-O2 inike i-30 mL ye-H2O, kushiyeke i-5 mL ye-O2, iyonke 35 mL. Ngoko $\mathrm{H_2:O_2:H_2O(g)} = 2:1:2$.
Inyathelo 2: Umthamo wehla usuka kwi-60 mL ukuya kwi-45 mL, ukuhla kwe-15 mL. Intsabela nganye yemithamo emi-3 ibe yi-2 ilahlekelwa ngomthamo omnye, olingana nomthamo we-$\mathrm{O_2}$ osabeleyo, ngoko i-$\mathrm{O_2}$ esabeleyo = 15 mL.
Inyathelo 3: Akusali $\mathrm{H_2}$, ngoko H2 esabeleyo = 15 x 2 = 30 mL, H2O(g) = 30 mL. Iyonke emva kwentsabela = 45 mL, ngoko i-$\mathrm{O_2}$ eshiyekileyo = 45 - 30 = 15 mL. I-$\mathrm{O_2}$ yokuqala = 15 + 15 = 30 mL, kwaye 30 + 30 = 60 mL iyahambelana.
Iimpendulo: 30 mL, 15 mL (b).
